types.name: permissions
types.description: The actor's effective `resource:operation` permissions, with wildcards already expanded.

types.name: roles
types.description: The actor's directly assigned roles, considering the resolved scope.

types.name: covered_roles
types.description:
Names of the roles the actor covers: roles whose grants are a subset of
the actor's effective permissions. Assigned roles are always covered, and
a super admin covers every role. Roles without policies are covered by
no one.
